CUSTOMER: Send $100.00 from checking to Alice. I confirm this transfer.
ASSISTANT: Your transfer of $100.00 from checking to Alice is complete (transfer ID: transfer-001). Your checking account was the source account. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CUSTOMER: The app showed a timeout. Did that transfer go through?
ASSISTANT: Yes, the transfer went through. Our records show one completed transfer: $100.00 from your checking account to Alice (transfer ID: transfer-001). The timeout didn't cause a duplicate, and I don't see a second transfer. Please don't send it again. If the app still shows the transfer as failed or pending, it may just be a display delay, and you can check your transfer history to confirm.
